title: ioctl_init/KEY_IMPORT/KEY_GENERATE: pr_info on hot path should be pr_debug
notes:
Three success-path pr_info calls in crypto2dev_fd.c emit an unconditional printk on every successful INIT, KEY_IMPORT, and KEY_GENERATE ioctl:
  - Line 802: 'crypto2dev: init dispatched to provider' (every INIT)
  - Line 1702: 'crypto2dev: KEY_IMPORT dispatched to provider'
  - Line 1991: 'crypto2dev: KEY_GENERATE dispatched to provider'
printk acquires a spinlock on the log buffer. For a TLS server at 1000 sessions/sec, this is 1000 printk calls/sec to dmesg — noisy and adds latency. These should be pr_debug(), which compiles to a no-op unless dynamic debug is enabled (CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG). The error paths (algo not found, etc.) correctly use pr_info_ratelimited, which is fine — those are exceptional. Only the success-path 'dispatched to' messages need to move to pr_debug.
